name: z-words-reminder
description: Periodic readability reminder for zcode: a UserPromptSubmit hook counts user messages per session and injects a reminder every 3rd message, asking the assistant to ground new concepts (terms, mechanism names, IDs) with one-sentence background before use, tag bare IDs with plain labels, and follow the global AGENTS.md wording lexicon.

description_i18n.en: Periodic readability reminder for zcode: a UserPromptSubmit hook counts user messages per session and injects a reminder every 3rd message, asking the assistant to ground new concepts (terms, mechanism names, IDs) with one-sentence background before use, tag bare IDs with plain labels, and follow the global AGENTS.md wording lexicon.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的周期性易读性提醒：UserPromptSubmit hook 按会话计数用户消息，每第 3 条注入一次提醒——要求对回复中本对话首次出现的概念（领域术语、机制名、编号、缩写）先用一句话铺垫背景再使用，编号带中文类型词不裸用，用语遵守全局 AGENTS.md 用语纪律词表。
